description.value:
Trigger You roll initiative

Traits Signal

You begin a Broadcast. It is up before any creature takes its first turn, whatever your initiative result, and you gain Encore at the start of your first turn as normal. If you are unable to act when the encounter begins, you cannot use this.

cinderfall.incomplete: Bucket 3 (hands the actor an early activation of a whole stance) stacked on SB3 (no Broadcast item to instantiate early). No "Broadcast" stance/aura item is ever instantiated as an Item with its own system.rules anywhere in this corpus. The shape (a stance whose aura buffs allies) is real and buildable in pf2e via Aura + a companion effect item -- but no such Broadcast item exists among this class's files to attach a rule element to.
